pages.text: The $(item)Flux Gate$() limits how much energy passes through it; the $(item)Fluid Gate$() does the same for fluids. Feed the back, take from the front. When you place a gate, its front (output) faces you.$(br2)Right-click it to set two rates:$(li)$(l)Redstone Signal Low$(): the flow with no signal.$(li)$(l)Redstone Signal High$(): the flow at signal strength 15.
Signals in between give a rate in between. Type a number and press Apply.

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: $(li)The flux gate counts in RF/t, the same as OP/t or FE/t. The fluid gate counts in mB/t.$(li)The Flow line shows the rate in use right now.$(li)High may be lower than Low, so a gate can also close when powered: set High to 0.$(li)A $(item)Potentiometer$() or a comparator makes a handy dial.$(li)With CC: Tweaked installed a computer can take over the gate; the screen then shows Overridden.
